raw_segments.text: Then Foma and both the women ran to the house, and saw this time that not only the window,
but also the door into the garden was wide open, though Fyodor Pavlovich had for the
last week locked himself in every night and did not allow even Grigory to come in on any
Seeing that door open, they were afraid to go into Fyodor Pavlovich, for fear anything
And when they returned to Grigory, the old man told them to go straight to the police
Marya Kondradievna ran there and gave the alarm to the whole party at the police captains.
She arrived only five minutes before Pyodor Ilyich, so that his story came, not as his
own surmise and theory, but as the direct confirmation, by a witness of the theory held
by all, as to the identity of the criminal.
A theory he had in the bottom of his heart refused to believe till that moment.
